title: 第17章 爱一个人需要理由吗第18章 父子谈心徐家隐秘
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
江尘发现。
这机缘商店简直就是一个百货商店。
里面各种各样的东西都有。
功法，秘术，武器，不仅有血脉，甚至连体质都可以兑换。
但越珍贵的东西。
他的价格自然也就越贵。
而想要兑换这些东西，则需要有足够的机缘值才行，江尘这一看才发现。
自己竟然有1103的机缘值。
【系统，这个机缘值怎么获得？】
〈叮！
〈机缘值的获取很简单，是根据宿主赠送机缘时的倍率而产生的，相应的倍数，对应了相应的机缘值。
【那机缘商店里的东西，我若是将他送给其他人，能不能从中获得暴击奖励。
〈可以获得暴击奖励，但为了防止宿主卡buug，赠送机缘商店内东西，无法获得积分奖励，并且一个月只能触发一次。
【艹……】
一听系统这话。
江尘忍不住爆了一句粗口。
按照系统的说法，自己将机缘商店的东西赠送给其他人，确实可以获得暴击奖励。
但不会获得相应的暴击积分。
并且。

还有一个月的冷却时间。
也就是说。
在机缘商店换取的东西，每个月只能触发一次暴击奖励。
若是再次二次兑换机缘物品赠予他人。
则不会获得任何奖励。
不过想了一想。
江尘也释然了。
对这个限制还是比较能理解的。
若是没有这个限制。
那自己什么都不用干，直接利用身边之人不断刷机缘值，躺在家提升实力就行了。
没有在这件事上多做纠结。
江尘开始沉吟了一会，将目光投向了武技的那一栏，现在他最缺的就是武技。
『黄阶上品武技《化骨掌》，兑换价格100点机缘值：』
『黄阶极品武技《游龙枪法》，兑换价格300点机缘值：』
……
《玄阶下品武技《破煞拳法》兑换价格500点机缘值；》
看了好一会后。
江尘咬了咬牙。
content_en:
………………
Jiang Chen discovered.
This chance store is simply a department store.
There are all kinds of things in there.
Kung Fu, secret techniques, weapons, not only bloodline, but even physique can be redeemed.
But the more precious things.
His price will naturally be more expensive.
To redeem these things, you need to have enough chance value, Jiang Chen discovered it after looking at it.
I actually have a chance value of 1103.
[System, how to obtain this chance value? 】
<Ding!
〈Obtaining the chance value is very simple. It is generated based on the multiplier when the host gifts the opportunity. The corresponding multiplier corresponds to the corresponding chance value.
[As for the items in the chance store, if I give them to others, can I get a critical hit reward from them?
〈Crit reward can be obtained, but in order to prevent the host card from bugging, gifts from the chance store cannot be obtained, and the point reward cannot be obtained, and it can only be triggered once a month.
【grass……】
As soon as I heard what the system said.
Jiang Chen couldn't help but curse.
According to the system, if you give items from the Chance Store to others, you can indeed get critical hit rewards.
But the corresponding critical points will not be obtained.
and.
There is still one month of cool down time.
That is to say.
Things exchanged in the Chance Shop can only trigger a critical strike reward once per month.
If you want to exchange chance items for a second time and give them to others.
You will not receive any rewards.
But think about it.
Jiang Chen was also relieved.
This restriction is quite understandable.
If there is no such restriction.
Then you don't have to do anything, just use the people around you to continuously increase your chance points, and just lie at home to improve your strength.
I didn’t dwell too much on this matter.
Jiang Chen began to ponder for a while and turned his attention to the column of martial arts. What he lacked the most now was martial arts.
"The yellow-level high-grade martial skill "Bone Transformation Palm", the exchange price is 100 chance points:"
"The top yellow level martial skill "Wandering Dragon Spear Technique", the exchange price is 300 chance points:"
…
"The exchange price of "Xuan-level low-grade martial arts "Shasha Fist" is 500 chance points;"
After watching for a while.
Jiang Chen gritted his teeth.
